content:
LinkedIn algorithm, are you okay? 😂

My posts usually take 2–3 days to reach 2K impressions.

Meanwhile, this comment of mine crossed 2K+ impressions in just ONE day. 😭😂

And the best part?

LinkedIn is also sending me notifications about it. 😂

At this point, I have some questions for the algorithm...

Are you trying to tell me that my comments are doing better than my posts? 👀

Because if yes, we need to have a serious conversation. 😂

LinkedIn, please explain yourself. 😭
